engine.name: whisper.cpp
engine.build: static ggml/whisper libraries, GGML_NATIVE=OFF, GGML_OPENMP=OFF, no ffmpeg, SDL, or curl

measured: 2026-11-04, native arm64 reference build of the whisper stage; the binary digest reproduces the proof's recorded arm64 build (dac1dc5c) byte for byte, and the library digests match the ocr.arm64.json entries for the same packages
notes: The binary digest is toolchain-dependent, not a universal pin: a rebuild with a different toolchain fails the Dockerfile gate until the reference is re-recorded. The whispercpp engine takes no per-file library pins (binary plus model only); the library list and set hash exist for the image gate.
